<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Tiendas Referidos Navideños</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Quicksand:wght@700&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;600;700&display=swap">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#F9F5F2; --panel:#EDE7DE; --fg:#241C16; --muted:#6B6156; --line:#E2DBD1; --row-alt:#F3EEE8;
  --coral:#E8462F; --coral-deep:#C03A24; --pine:#1C6B4A; --lav:#C9CCF4; --ink:#241C16; --cream:#F9F5F2;
  --head:'Quicksand',system-ui,sans-serif; --font:'Manrope',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:var(--font);font-size:16px;line-height:1.45}
a{color:var(--coral-deep)}a:hover{color:var(--pine)}
.wrap{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding-left:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
.ic{display:block;flex:none}

/* HEAD */
.head{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--coral);color:var(--cream)}
.head canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}
.head .wrap{position:relative;padding-block:56px 64px;display:grid;gap:22px}
.logo{display:flex;flex-direction:column;font-family:var(--head);font-weight:700;font-size:30px;line-height:.84;letter-spacing:-.045em;text-transform:uppercase}
.logo span:last-child{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:5px;color:var(--lav)}
.eyebrow{justify-self:start;background:var(--cream);color:var(--coral-deep);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 20px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:13px}
.head h1{margin:0;font-family:var(--head);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(38px,7vw,72px);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.04em;text-wrap:balance;max-width:13ch}
.head p{margin:0;font-size:clamp(17px,2.2vw,21px);font-weight:300;max-width:42ch}
.dates{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.dates span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;border:2px solid rgba(249,245,242,.6);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 16px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.ornaments{position:absolute;right:max(140px,12vw);top:0;display:flex;gap:26px;align-items:flex-start}
.orn img{display:block;margin-top:-4px;filter:drop-shadow(-14px 26px 32px rgba(110,26,12,.48))}
@media (max-width:1100px){.head-star{display:none}}
.head-star{position:absolute;right:max(60px,6vw);top:170px;width:78px;transform:rotate(-10deg);filter:drop-shadow(-14px 26px 32px rgba(110,26,12,.48))}
.head-bow{position:absolute;right:24px;top:18px;width:75px;transform:rotate(-8deg);filter:drop-shadow(-14px 26px 32px rgba(110,26,12,.48))}
@media (max-width:760px){.head-star,.head-bow{opacity:.45}}
.o{display:block;flex:none;height:auto;filter:drop-shadow(-3px 6px 6px rgba(28,60,45,.22))}
.band-o{filter:drop-shadow(-6px 10px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.32))}
.dates img{width:26px;height:auto;display:block;filter:drop-shadow(-3px 6px 6px rgba(110,26,12,.4))}
.orn{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.orn i{width:2px;background:var(--cream)}
@media (max-width:760px){.ornaments{opacity:.4}}
.ribbon{height:56px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;padding-left:24px;background:var(--lav);white-space:nowrap}
.ribbon div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;flex:none;font-family:var(--head);font-weight:700;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-transform:uppercase}

/* FILTROS */
.controls{display:grid;gap:16px;padding-block:36px 8px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.chip{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid var(--ink);background:transparent;color:var(--fg);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 20px 6px 10px;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.chip strong{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em}
.chip small{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.chip:hover{background:var(--panel)}
.chip[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream)}
.chip[aria-pressed="true"] small{color:inherit;opacity:.75}
.chip:focus-visible,.search input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--coral);outline-offset:2px}
.search{position:relative;max-width:520px}
.search .ic{position:absolute;left:16px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);pointer-events:none}
.search input{font:inherit;width:100%;padding:14px 16px 14px 48px;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;color:var(--fg)}
.count{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;margin:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}

/* REGIONES */
.region{margin-top:40px}
.band{background:var(--pine);color:var(--cream)}
.band .wrap{padding-block:20px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 24px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.band h2{margin:0;font-family:var(--head);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,38px);letter-spacing:-.035em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;white-space:nowrap;flex:none}
.band .meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 20px;font-size:15px}
.band .meta span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.band .meta b{font-weight:700}
.tablebox{overflow-x:auto}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;min-width:1040px}
th{text-align:left;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;padding:16px 12px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--fg);white-space:nowrap}
th div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
td{padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:middle}
tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:var(--row-alt)}
td.t{font-weight:700}
td.d span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:var(--lav);color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 12px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap}
td.p{color:var(--muted);font-style:italic}
td.n,th.n{text-align:center;width:110px}
th.n div{justify-content:center}
.n span{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--coral);color:#fff;font-weight:700}
.brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid var(--fg);white-space:nowrap}
.brand.is{border-style:dashed}
.state-row td{background:var(--panel);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:9px 12px;color:var(--fg)}
.state-row td div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.empty{padding:40px 0;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.who{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;white-space:nowrap}
.who i{display:grid;place-items:center;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--panel);color:var(--coral-deep);flex:none}
footer{margin-top:56px;background:var(--coral);color:var(--cream)}
footer .wrap{padding-block:32px;font-size:15px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}

@media print{.controls,.ribbon{display:none!important}td{padding:5px 10px!important}.state-row td{padding:4px 10px!important}.n span{min-width:22px!important;height:22px!important;font-size:12px}.head .wrap{padding-block:36px 32px!important}.region{margin-top:18px!important}footer{margin-top:20px!important}table{min-width:0}.region{break-inside:auto}.band{break-after:avoid}tr{break-inside:avoid}body{-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="head">
  <canvas id="snow" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
  <div class="ornaments" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="orn"><i style="height:50px"></i><img data-o="esfera" alt="" style="width:80px"></div>
    <div class="orn"><i style="height:110px"></i><img data-o="cascabel" alt="" style="width:60px"></div>
    <div class="orn"><i style="height:20px"></i><img data-o="esfera" alt="" style="width:64px"></div>
  </div>
  <img class="head-star" data-o="estrella" alt="" aria-hidden="true">
  <img class="head-bow" data-o="mono" alt="" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="logo" aria-label="Navidad Is Magic"><span>Navidad</span><span>Is Magic<svg class="ic" width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 220 220"><path d="M110 10 C118 88 132 102 210 110 C132 118 118 132 110 210 C102 132 88 118 10 110 C88 102 102 88 110 10 Z" fill="#F9F5F2"></path></svg></span></div>
    <div class="eyebrow">Programa referidos</div>
    <h1>Tiendas participantes</h1>
    <p>Consulta en qué tiendas hay vacantes eventuales, organizadas por región, junto con tu distrito, reclutadora y HRBP.</p>
    <div class="dates"><span><img data-o="estrella" alt="">9 noviembre – 8 enero</span><span><img data-o="mono" alt="">Busca a tu reclutadora</span><span><img data-o="regalo" alt="">Bono por referido</span></div>
  </div>
</header>
<div class="ribbon" aria-hidden="true"><div>Programa referidos<svg class="ic" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 220 220"><path d="M110 10 C118 88 132 102 210 110 C132 118 118 132 110 210 C102 132 88 118 10 110 C88 102 102 88 110 10 Z" fill="#1C6B4A"></path></svg></div><div>Programa referidos<svg class="ic" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 220 220"><path d="M110 10 C118 88 132 102 210 110 C132 118 118 132 110 210 C102 132 88 118 10 110 C88 102 102 88 110 10 Z" fill="#1C6B4A"></path></svg></div><div>Programa referidos<svg class="ic" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 220 220"><path d="M110 10 C118 88 132 102 210 110 C132 118 118 132 110 210 C102 132 88 118 10 110 C88 102 102 88 110 10 Z" fill="#1C6B4A"></path></svg></div><div>Programa referidos<svg class="ic" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 220 220"><path d="M110 10 C118 88 132 102 210 110 C132 118 118 132 110 210 C102 132 88 118 10 110 C88 102 102 88 110 10 Z" fill="#1C6B4A"></path></svg></div><div>Programa referidos<svg class="ic" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 220 220"><path d="M110 10 C118 88 132 102 210 110 C132 118 118 132 110 210 C102 132 88 118 10 110 C88 102 102 88 110 10 Z" fill="#1C6B4A"></path></svg></div><div>Programa referidos<svg class="ic" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 220 220"><path d="M110 10 C118 88 132 102 210 110 C132 118 118 132 110 210 C102 132 88 118 10 110 C88 102 102 88 110 10 Z" fill="#1C6B4A"></path></svg></div><div>Programa referidos<svg class="ic" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 220 220"><path d="M110 10 C118 88 132 102 210 110 C132 118 118 132 110 210 C102 132 88 118 10 110 C88 102 102 88 110 10 Z" fill="#1C6B4A"></path></svg></div><div>Programa referidos<svg class="ic" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 220 220"><path d="M110 10 C118 88 132 102 210 110 C132 118 118 132 110 210 C102 132 88 118 10 110 C88 102 102 88 110 10 Z" fill="#1C6B4A"></path></svg></div></div>

<main>
  <div class="wrap controls">
    <div class="chips" role="group" aria-label="Filtrar por región" id="chips"></div>
    <label class="search"><svg class="ic" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#6B6156" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6.5"></circle><path d="M16 16l4.5 4.5"></path></svg><input id="q" type="search" placeholder="Busca una tienda, estado, distrito, VCD, reclutadora o HRBP" aria-label="Buscar"></label>
    <p class="count" id="count"></p>
  </div>
  <div id="list"></div>
</main>

<footer><div class="wrap"><img data-o="mono" alt="" style="width:56px;filter:drop-shadow(-8px 14px 18px rgba(110,26,12,.48))"><span>¿Dudas? Contacta a tu VCD y HRBP.</span></div></footer>

const PEND = 'Pendiente';
const ICO = {"gift":"<rect x=\"3.5\" y=\"9\" width=\"17\" height=\"11.5\" rx=\"1\"></rect><path d=\"M2.5 9h19v-3h-19zM12 6v14.5\"></path><path d=\"M12 6c-1.5-3-5-3.5-5-1.2C7 6 9.5 6 12 6zM12 6c1.5-3 y=\"13.5\" width=\"7\" height=\"7\" rx=\"1\"></rect><rect x=\"13.5\" y=\"13.5\" width=\"7\" height=\"7\" rx=\"1\"></rect>","mail":"<rect x=\"3\" y=\"5\" width=\"18\" height=\"14\" r=\"1\"></circle><circle cx=\"4.5\" cy=\"12\" r=\"1\"></circle><circle cx=\"4.5\" cy=\"18\" r=\"1\"></circle>","cal":"<rect x=\"3\" y=\"5\" width=\"18\" height=\"16\" rx=\"2\"></rect><path d=\"M3 21z\"></path><circle cx=\"12\" cy=\"9.5\" r=\"2.5\"></circle>","map":"<path d=\"M9 4L3.5 6v14L9 18l6 2 5.5-2V4L15 6 9 4z\"></path><path d=\"M9 4v14M15 6v14\"></path>","user":"<circle cx=\"12\" fill=\"currentColor\"></circle>"};
const ic = (k,s=16) => `<svg class="ic" width="${s}" height="${s}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${ICO[k]}</svg>`;
DATA.forEach(d=>{const x=DIST[d.t]||{}; d.d=x.d||''; d.rec=x.rec||''; d.hrbp=x.hrbp||'';});

const REG = {};
DATA.forEach(d=>{(REG[d.r] ||= {vcr:d.vcr,rows:[],n:0}); REG[d.r].rows.push(d); REG[d.r].n += d.n;});
const regs = Object.keys(REG).map(Number).sort();
let active = 0;
try{ active = +(localStorage.getItem('reg')||0) || 0; if(!REG[active]) active=0; }catch(e){}
const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
const norm = s => String(s).normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase();
const total = DATA.reduce((a,d)=>a+d.n,0);
const cell = (v,cls='',k='') => v ? `<td class="${cls}">${cls==='d'?`<span>${ic('pin',13)}${esc(v)}</span>`:`<div class="who">${k?`<i>${ic(k,14)}</i>`:''}${esc(v)}</div>`}</td>` : `<td class="p">${PEND}</td>`;

function chips(){
  const items = [{k:0,label:'Todas',o:'arbol',sub:`${DATA.length} tiendas · ${total} eventuales`}]
    .concat(regs.map(r=>({k:r,label:`Región ${r}`,o:['esfera','estrella','regalo'][(r-1)%3],sub:`${REG[r].rows.length} tiendas · ${REG[r].n} eventuales`})));
  document.getElementById('chips').innerHTML = items.map(i=>
    `<button class="chip" type="button" data-k="${i.k}" aria-pressed="${i.k===active}">${obj(i.o,26)}<strong>${i.label}</strong><small>${i.sub}</small></button>`).join('');
}
function render(){
  const q = norm(document.getElementById('q').value.trim());
  let html='', shown=0, ev=0;
  regs.filter(r=>!active||r===active).forEach(r=>{
    const rows = REG[r].rows.filter(d=>!q || norm([d.t,d.e,d.vcd,d.m,d.d,d.rec,d.hrbp].join(' ')).includes(q));
    if(!rows.length) return;
    shown += rows.length; const n = rows.reduce((a,d)=>a+d.n,0); ev += n;
    let body='', last='';
    rows.forEach(d=>{
      if(d.e!==last){ body += `<tr class="state-row"><td colspan="7"><div>${obj('estrella',20)}${esc(d.e)}</div></td></tr>`; last=d.e; }
      body += `<tr><td class="t">${esc(d.t)}</td><td><span class="brand ${d.m==='Isadora'?'is':''}">${ic('tag',13)}${esc(d.m)}</span></td>${cell(d.d,'d')}${cell(d.vcd,'','user')}${cell(d.rec,'','mail')}${cell(d.hrbp,'','heart')}<td class="n"><span>${d.n}</span></td></tr>`;
    });
    html += `<section class="region"><div class="band"><div class="wrap"><h2>${obj(['esfera','estrella','regalo'][(r-1)%3],46,'o band-o')}Región ${r}</h2>
      <div class="meta"><span>${ic('user',18)}VCR <b>${esc(REG[r].vcr)}</b></span><span>${ic('store',18)}<b>${rows.length}</b> tiendas</span><span>${ic('users',18)}<b>${n}</b> eventuales</span></div></div></div>
      <div class="wrap tablebox"><table><thead><tr><th><div>${ic('store',15)}Tienda</div></th><th><div>${ic('bag',15)}Marca</div></th><th><div>${ic('map',15)}Distrito</div></th><th><div>${ic('user',15)}VCD</div></th><th><div>${ic('search2',15)}Reclutadora</div></th><th><div>${ic('heart',15)}HRBP</div></th><th class="n"><div>${ic('users',15)}Eventuales</div></th></tr></thead><tbody>${body}</tbody></table></div></section>`;
  });
  document.getElementById('list').innerHTML = html || `<div class="wrap empty">${obj('cascabel',40)}No encontramos tiendas con esa búsqueda. Revisa la ortografía o elige “Todas”.</div>`;
  document.getElementById('count').innerHTML = `${obj('regalo',22)}Mostrando <b>${shown}</b> tiendas · <b>${ev}</b> eventuales`;
}
document.getElementById('chips').addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const b=e.target.closest('.chip'); if(!b) return;
  active=+b.dataset.k; try{localStorage.setItem('reg',active)}catch(e){}
  chips(); render();
});
document.getElementById('q').addEventListener('input',render);
chips(); render();

/* nieve */
(function(){
  const c=document.getElementById('snow'), x=c.getContext('2d');
  const still = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  let W,H,f=[];
  function size(){W=c.width=c.offsetWidth*devicePixelRatio;H=c.height=c.offsetHeight*devicePixelRatio;
    f=Array.from({length:Math.round(W*H/9000/devicePixelRatio)},()=>({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,r:(Math.random()*2.4+0.8)*devicePixelRatio,s:Math.random()*.5+.2,w:Math.random()*6}));}
  function draw(){x.clearRect(0,0,W,H);x.fillStyle='rgba(249,245,242,.7)';
    f.forEach(p=>{x.beginPath();x.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,7);x.fill();
      if(!still){p.y+=p.s*devicePixelRatio;p.w+=.01;p.x+=Math.sin(p.w)*.3;if(p.y>H){p.y=-4;p.x=Math.random()*W}}});
    if(!still) requestAnimationFrame(draw);}
  size(); addEventListener('resize',()=>{size(); if(still) draw();}); draw();
})();
</script>
